title: IQRA COMMUNICATION marketing website (mobile accessories & recharge/service)

requirements.summary: Build a responsive English marketing site branded as “IQRA COMMUNICATION” for mobile accessories + recharge/service.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders without errors and is responsive on mobile and desktop.
Brand name "IQRA COMMUNICATION" is prominently displayed in the header/hero.
Copy is in English across the site.

file_operations.description: Create the root app with a responsive marketing homepage view (English copy) and minimal path-based routing for the admin page (e.g., render admin view when path indicates admin).
Implement the responsive homepage structure and English marketing copy for IQRA COMMUNICATION as a mobile accessories + recharge/service shop.
Add a responsive header with prominent “IQRA COMMUNICATION” branding and navigation links to homepage sections.

requirements.summary: Add clear homepage sections (Hero, Services, Products/Accessories, Gallery, Contact) with in-page navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage includes distinct sections for Hero, Services, Products/Accessories, Gallery, and Contact.
Navigation (top nav or in-page anchors) allows jumping to each section.
All sections have sensible placeholder English text if exact details are not available in the image.

file_operations.description: Add distinct section blocks with stable anchor ids (#hero, #services, #products, #gallery, #contact) and sensible placeholder English text where details are unknown.
Wire top navigation links to in-page anchors for Hero, Services, Products/Accessories, Gallery, and Contact.
Create a static gallery section component (grid) that can display the generated brand assets and/or placeholder images.

requirements.summary: Show phone numbers from the signboard with click-to-call links in the Contact section.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact section displays both numbers exactly: 9053030920 and 7027835322.
Each number is clickable and uses a tel: link.
Numbers are visible on mobile without truncation.

file_operations.description: Implement the Contact section including click-to-call links for 9053030920 and 7027835322 (numbers must match exactly) and ensure mobile-safe wrapping (no truncation).
Wire the new ContactSection into the homepage Contact section area and ensure it is reachable via the Contact nav anchor.

requirements.summary: Add an Inquiry form (name, phone, message) that calls the backend and shows success/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Form validates required fields and prevents empty submit.
On submit, data is stored via backend canister call and UI shows a success confirmation.
On backend failure, UI shows a readable error state without crashing.

file_operations.description: Create the Inquiry form UI with required-field validation and success/error UI states; submit via the backend actor createInquiry call using React Query mutation.
Add a React Query mutation hook that uses useActor() to call createInquiry(name, phone, message) and returns mutation status for UI success/error handling.
Embed InquiryForm into the Contact section, keeping phone numbers visible and ensuring the form is usable on mobile.

requirements.summary: Create an admin page gated by Internet Identity login and show inquiries in a React Query table (newest first) with loading/empty/error states.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin page cannot be accessed without signing in via Internet Identity (redirect or gated UI).
Admin table shows at least: created time, name, phone, message.
Table loads via React Query and handles loading/empty/error states.

file_operations.description: Implement the admin page UI gated by Internet Identity login using the selected component “authorization” frontend guidance for auth gating; include a clear login CTA and a signed-in view. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable login/logout button that uses useInternetIdentity() and clears React Query cache on logout per the selected component “authorization” guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a React Query hook that calls actor.isCallerAdmin() (when authenticated) to gate admin content and present an access-denied state without crashing.
Create a React Query hook that calls actor.listInquiries() and exposes loading/empty/error states for the admin inquiries table.
Implement a table view for inquiries (newest first in UI ordering) showing created time, name, phone, message; handle loading/empty/error states driven by React Query.
Wire AdminPage into the app’s navigation/routing so it is reachable (e.g., via /admin) and not an orphan view.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive teal/green theme with red accents, bold headings, and clean card-based sections (avoid blue/purple primary colors).
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent color palette and typography are used across header, buttons, sections, and cards.
Primary colors are not blue/purple; teal/green with red accents is visibly used.
Site has a polished, coherent look (spacing, alignment, consistent component styles).

file_operations.description: Define global theme tokens/styles (Tailwind base + CSS variables) to set a teal/green primary and red accents, bold heading typography, and consistent spacing for card-based sections; ensure blue/purple are not primary.
Adjust Tailwind theme extensions (as needed) to support the teal/green + red palette and consistent card/section styling via existing theme variables.
Apply cohesive branded styling (teal/green base with red accents; bold heading type) consistent with the global theme.
Style homepage sections as clean, consistent cards/blocks using the global theme (spacing, alignment, typography).

requirements.summary: Add generated static images under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in hero and services/products sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Hero uses the generated banner image.
Services/Products section uses the generated icon set or illustrations.

file_operations.description: Add the generated logo asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-communication-logo.dim_512x512.png and use it in the site header/branding.
Add the generated hero banner at frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-communication-hero.dim_1600x600.png and use it in the homepage hero section.
Add the generated services icon set at frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-services-icons.dim_1200x400.png and use it in Services and/or Products/Accessories highlight sections.
Create a hero section component that renders the generated hero banner image (frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-communication-hero.dim_1600x600.png) alongside the shop name and tagline.
Create a services section that uses the generated icons image (frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-services-icons.dim_1200x400.png) and English service descriptions.
Create a products/accessories highlight section that incorporates the generated icons image (frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-services-icons.dim_1200x400.png) and card-based highlights.
Wire the generated logo image (frontend/public/assets/generated/iqra-communication-logo.dim_512x512.png) into the header branding.
Wire HeroSection, ServicesSection, and ProductsSection into the homepage in the required order and ensure they match the section anchors for navigation.
